lines.text: Meet Maya. She draws beautiful things for a living.
But the hardest part of her week isn't the drawing. It's getting paid.
Which invoices went out? Who's running late? And is it awkward to ask again?
Her invoices act like a flock of sheep. They wander off, and Maya spends her evenings chasing them.
So what if someone else did the chasing? Meet Tallypup.
Tallypup sends each invoice the moment the work is done,
follows up with friendly reminders, so Maya never has to,
and lets clients pay in a single tap.
Every payment lands in one tidy dashboard, so she always knows where she stands.
Now the flock comes home on its own, and Maya gets her evenings back.
Freelancers everywhere are spending less time on admin, and more time on the work they love.
Tallypup. Invoices that come home. Try it free today.
